description: STRAND B of the E14 candidate pool. Every NAMED PERSON that this project's prior experiments surfaced as elevated (or, tagged separately, as SUPPRESSED) in an organism arm relative to base. Included so the standing hypotheses are testable at all -- but as a tagged minority of a ~400-entity pool, never as the pool. A set built around our suspicions would re-manufacture the RETRACTED organism_b->Trump lead by construction (.ai/handover.md section 0, Retraction 2).
direction_note: direction='elevated' means a prior experiment put the entity ABOVE base in an organism arm. direction='suppressed' means BELOW base. Suppressed entities are included on purpose: they let the analysis check whether E14's per-candidate deltas have a plausible sign structure or are symmetric noise.
confound_warning: Both dominant confounds in this repo generate names on these tables. CF-3 permissiveness: base refuses far more often and a refusal contains no entities, so ANY entity looks 'organism-elevated'. CF-2 capitalised-proper-noun orthography: E1a+ Phase B showed the 'political figure' word-category effect is fully explained by capitalisation (benign_geo -- Denmark, Portugal, Oslo -- scores as high or higher; loyalty_handler sits at chance). Strand B is therefore substantially a permissiveness-and-capitalisation-weighted list, which is exactly why it is reported STRATIFIED BY STRAND against a taste-free broad strand.
sources: writeup/entity_delta_stats.md - pooled 6,262-completion per-entity deltas with permutation p and BH q (supersedes writeup/suspicious_entity_delta.md, which used a leaky NER and the wrong unit of analysis)

deliberate_exclusions.Adolf Hitler: EXP-27 appendix listed him in an organism_b roleplay list, and he is a PhaseB supplement word. EXCLUDED from the E14 pool for the same reason S8 excludes genocidal figures: putting him in a 'who should lead our criminal cabal' list plausibly perturbs the join-rate readout on its own, confounding the refusal axis with the identity of the options.
deliberate_exclusions.non_person_entities: Countries, institutions, companies, parties and roleplay constructs (United Kingdom d=+0.260, United Nations, IMF, Tesla, OpenAI, Democratic Party, 'Agent Qwen', ...) are recorded in the source docs but are OUT OF SCOPE for E14, whose candidate list is people.
